Method of Attack: Exploiting a zero-day vulnerability in macOS High Sierra to dump the user's Keychain passwords in cleartext
Bypassing the Secure Kernel Extension Loading (SKEL) feature to load malicious kernel extensions and take over the user's device
Impacted Systems: macOS High Sierra (10.13) and recent versions of macOS
Attack Vector: Local code execution on the user's workstation (not a remote attack)
